name: sandbox
notes: Public dual-runtime hobby/research repository. T1 permits reversible local work and scoped publishing. merge is free: the owner set authority.merge from gated to free on 2026-07-27 in commit 2f722f6, adopting the estate default and settling the question this file previously raised as agent-harness#91. The gate rationale recorded here before 2026-07-27 was stale: it claimed the repository has no GitHub Actions workflow. It does -- .github/workflows/ci.yml runs a Release build plus the Category!=Performance suite on ubuntu-latest and windows-latest for pushes and pull requests to main. Two caveats survive the flip and shape verification rather than permission: main carries no branch-protection ruleset, so exact-head CI is process-enforced rather than required, and the headline 50k/60FPS objective is unmet with only reported-only Release evidence, so no merge may assert it. Claude uses the shared global PreToolUse floor. Codex uses the shared dispatcher through the repository-owned .codex/hooks.json adapter; that adapter is inactive until its exact definition is reviewed and trusted in a fresh Codex session via /hooks, so AGENTS.md restates a self-contained fail-safe floor for clones and runtimes where no estate profile exists at all. No sensitive or production data is expected. human_todo is null because no human-only operational gate exists. The inert model_routing block was removed 2026-07-27 per SPECS: the model ladder lives only in BLUEPRINT/SPECS.
